# AutoDrive SafeStop Perception & Braking System Architecture

## Intended Purpose and Operational Scope
AutoDrive SafeStop serves as an AI safety component for heavy goods vehicles, initiating autonomous collision avoidance braking when forward sensors detect obstacles or pedestrians.

## Risk Management System (Article 9)
A continuous risk management system compliant with ISO 26262 (ASIL-D) and EU AI Act Article 9 is maintained. Rigorous hazard and operability studies (HAZOP) run dynamically with automated hardware-in-the-loop validation.

## Data Governance & Training Lineage (Article 10)
Training data governance covers over 1.2 million kilometers of multi-weather sensor feeds (LiDAR, radar, cameras). Dataset quality checks, sensor noise modeling, and environmental coverage audits are fully documented.

## Bias Examination and Mitigation (Article 10(2)(f))
Bias examination and mitigation controls are fully implemented. Detection sensitivity and false-negative rates across varied pedestrian heights, mobility aids, wheelchairs, and reflective clothing have been verified with equalized performance.

## Technical Documentation (Article 11)
Full technical documentation compliant with Annex IV and UNECE vehicle regulations is maintained in the secure engineering archive.

## Automated Logging & Record-Keeping (Article 12)
Immutable event data recorder (EDR) automated logging captures all sensor activations, perception confidence scores, and deceleration profiles.

## Transparency & Instructions for Use (Article 13)
Comprehensive driver-assistance operating manuals, operational design domain (ODD) boundaries, and instrument cluster warning displays are provided.

## Human Oversight & Emergency Intervention (Article 14)
A multi-stage human oversight mechanism allows human driver override via steering input or manual brake pedal depression at all times. An emergency stop fail safe mechanism and dual-redundant kill switch are fully operational.

## Accuracy, Robustness and Cybersecurity (Article 15)
The perception subsystem achieves 99.8% obstacle classification accuracy under adverse weather. Robustness defenses and ISO/SAE 21434 vehicle cybersecurity controls against sensor spoofing and CAN bus tampering are active.
